en.headline: Fire Services to step up patrols at 12 high-risk sites ahead of Chung Yeung
en.dek: More than 250 personnel will form 12 teams with Civil Aid Service members, while new large drones carrying 80 litres of water and AI image analysis will support operations.
body: The Fire Services Department said it would strengthen patrols and contingency deployments for Chung Yeung Festival, focusing on 12 locations with relatively higher hill-fire risk in the New Territories West and North.

Civil Aid Service members will join Fire Services personnel to form 12 patrol teams on site. The locations include areas in Yuen Long, Pat Heung and Sheung Shui. A senior command post has been set up in the New Territories North Division, with other divisions establishing command facilities as needed.

Deputy Divisional Commander (New Territories North) Fung Chi-keung said there are typically about 600 hill fires a year, and an average of around 30 in the two weeks around Chung Yeung over the past decade, depending on weather. With fine weather expected on Sunday and relative humidity between 60 and 80 per cent, more people are likely to go hill-climbing and grave-sweeping, raising the overall risk.

The department will deploy three innovative technology applications, including a remote aerial detection system, a real-time AI image analysis platform, and a newly introduced large drone equipped with an 80-litre water-drop system to provide aerial support in remote or steep areas.

zh.headline: 消防處重陽節加強巡邏12個山火高危地點 引入大型無人機
zh.dek: 聯同民安隊組成12支巡邏小隊，並動用遙距偵測、人工智能影像分析及可載80公升水彈的大型無人機協助。
body: 消防處表示，將就重陽節加強巡邏及應變部署，鎖定12個山火風險相對較高地點，全部位於新界西及新界北，包括元朗橫洲、八鄉芝麻嶺及上水石湖新村等。
民安隊會聯同消防處人員組成12支巡邏小隊在現場加強巡邏。新界北總區已設立高級指揮室，其他行動總區亦會按需要設立指揮設施。
新界北分區副指揮官馮志強指，每年約有600多宗山火，過去十年重陽節前後兩星期平均約30宗，視乎天氣。目前預測周日天晴，相對濕度約60至80%，預計有不少市民登山掃墓，山火風險增加，當局已做好部署。
處方會動用三項創新科技，包括遙距空中偵測系統、實時人工智能影像分析平台，以及新引入可負重80公升載水裝置的大型無人機，為偏遠或陡峭位置提供空中輔助支援。
